title: Teleological taxonomy for SciML architecture selection: schema and reference implementation
description: Machine-readable taxonomy schema (11 decision nodes, 16 architecture families), reference implementation of the selection and composition algorithms with their declared failure modes, structural analysis, and the case-study task descriptors as regression tests. Accompanies Wiens and Reich, 'From Descriptive Classification to Prescriptive Selection: A Goal-Oriented Taxonomy, Decision Protocol and Machine-Readable Schema for Scientific Machine Learning Architectures', the extended version of a paper presented at SIMULTECH 2026.
